description: Generate a complete `item` document (form of `action`) with summary and metadata elements. JSON outline here is useful, but any details in prompt instructions should override.
name: createAction

content.description: Include entire, or snippets, original Member conversation regarding this `action`

conviction.description: Conviction level of `action` from 0-10, where 0 is no conviction and 10 is full conviction

ease_of_execution.description: Ease of execution level of `action` from 0-10, where 0 is very difficult and 10 is very easy

form.description: Primary form of `action`, which may be one of: `petition`, `protest`, `donation`, `volunteering`, `education`, or `other`; if multiple, use comma-separated string with all relevant forms

issues.description: Issues most relevant to `action`, include any relevant ideology, movement, etc. for political actions; can be empty if none articulated or unknown

keywords.description: Keywords most relevant to `action`, include any relevant ideology, movement, or issue keywords for political actions

steps.description: Ordered Step-by-step instructions for how to execute `action`, even if only one step

order.description: Order of this step in overall instructions

summary.description: Generate summary of `action` content, ideally max of 5 sentences

title.description: Generate short display Title for `action` based on content

type.description: MyLife System type of `action`, always `action` for this function

values.description: Related `values` for this `action`, can be empty if none articulated or unknown
